guarantees.claim: txcount is set to 0 when rst_ni is low, and to txcount_d otherwise, on every positive edge of clk_i.

uncertain_points.claim: The value of txcount is fully determined by external signal txcount_d; the generation logic for txcount_d must be verified to ensure correct HMAC message length tracking.
uncertain_points.risk: If txcount_d is incorrectly computed, txcount may hold an invalid count, potentially leading to HMAC digest errors.
